finding: The landed grouped-dict integrated A/B is diagnostic-only until its evaluator is hardened to the frozen preregistration.
decisive_gaps: Current passed_child uses min(structured)<=0.90, so one Shifted/Boundary child win can mask a held-out structured regression; the prereg requires no meaningful held-out wall regression.
Incompressible is measured but not part of passed_child even though it is a frozen zero-edge control.
Child exactness checks archive SHA only; the prereg also requires strong tree identity plus candidate-count, accepted-edge, central-base assignment and pack-plan/locality equivalence.
Child peak_rss_kib is self ru_maxrss rather than sampled process-tree RSS.
Complete-product wall/RSS are recorded when --product is used but do not control final pass/fail or process exit.
Product RSS sampling continues while strong verification/archive materialization still run in the measured child, conflating proof memory with create RSS.

child_exactness: semantic trace exact for candidate discovery, accepted measured-edge facts, central-base assignment and pack-plan/locality facts
hardening_contract.structured_positive: At least one preregistered exposed structured row must show >=10% same-run child wall reduction.
hardening_contract.held_out_wall: Boundary, False Neighbors and Incompressible must not show a confirmed child slowdown under the existing >5% AND >3ms timing rule.
hardening_contract.rss: Use sampled whole live process-tree RSS in a build-only pass; keep proof/verification outside the RSS claim.
hardening_contract.product: When --product is requested, final archive/tree identity and complete-product wall non-regression must participate in the decision; a child-only green cannot earn product credit.

next_decisive_action: Harden the evaluator without changing the grouped historical-dict mechanism, workloads, comparators or frozen decision thresholds; then run the frozen paired A/B.
claim_boundary: Evaluator-custody correction only. No benchmark result, product mutation or release credit.
